changelog: Codebase audit fixes: TV mini player now retries on playback error (was permanently stuck black on any network blip, unlike phone) and re-fetches to the live edge on resume (was resuming a stale buffered position). Removed a runBlocking DataStore read from the DNS lookup path used by every network request, which could stall unrelated requests under load. Bounded a blocking DB write in recording-service teardown to 3s so a locked DB can't risk an ANR. Consolidated duplicated play/share-recording logic between phone and TV into one shared helper.
